admission.justification: Realized by the publication classifier, the server's dispatch check and the refusal builder; tests show every declared publication refused before its handler while reads, dry runs and messages still answer. It keeps an old build from landing work under gates the installed build changed.

applicability: Tool calls to an MCP server whose installed build reads stale.
conditions: The call is one of the declared publication operations and is not a dry run.
exclusions: Reads, dry runs, messages and planning calls, which answer with the stale annotation.
Processes running from a source checkout and builds whose currentness is unknown, which are never refused.
Tool names that are not declared publications.
